paper.title_en: Spectral rigidity of manifolds with Ricci bounded below and maximal bottom spectrum
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the spectrum of the Laplacian on complete, non-compact manifolds $M^n$ whose Ricci curvature satisfies $ \textrm{Ric}\ge -(n-1)\textrm{H}(r), $ for some continuous, non-increasing $\textrm{H}$ with $\textrm{H}-1 \in L^1(\infty )$. We prove that if the bottom spectrum attains the maximal value $\frac{(n-1)^2}{4}$ compatible with the curvature bound, then the spectrum of M coincides with that of $\mathbb {H}^n$, namely, $ \sigma (M) = \left[ \frac{(n-1)^2}{4}, \infty \right) . $The result can be localized to an end E with infinite volume.
